pose_matching.scope: Same requested direct targets and unchanged tolerances; actual endpoint differences retained, not forced or teleported.

protocol.scope: Rendered-depth and geometric predictions compared on identical deterministic physical-surface quadrature; GT used only after capture for evaluation.
protocol.union: Per-object pointwise union of actual native masks across cameras, with true physical area weights.
protocol.pixel_scope: Exact per-camera pixel counts from independent first intersections matched to rendered depth within5mm; image-coordinate pixels across cameras are not physically deduplicated.
protocol.comparison: Only common posture/scenario/object conditions enter cross-layout summary; all source rows, missing-posture errors and failed movements remain retained.
protocol.primary_nonoverlap: Conservative actual robot-mesh/enclosing-fixture-box flags exclude potential intersections from primary metrics. All65conditions remain in stress-context metrics. Flags transfer only after actual robot endpoint poses match within1e-7m/rad.
protocol.timing: Full captures and scoring are excluded from runtime performance claims.
